name: @photo-tools/filex-desktop
description: FileX Suite desktop shell for Windows packaging and native bridge work.
author: FileX

scripts.build:shell: npm run generate:google-drive-config && npm run sync:branding && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.build:suite: npm run build:shell && npm run build:suite-launcher
scripts.build:image-party-frame: npm run build:shell && npm --workspace @photo-tools/image-party-frame-app run build && npm --workspace @photo-tools/image-party-frame-app run build:server && node ./scripts/copy-image-party-frame-server.mjs
scripts.build:batch-print-layout: npm run build:shell && npm --workspace @photo-tools/batch-print-layout run build
scripts.build:archivio-flow: npm run build:shell && npm --workspace @photo-tools/archivio-flow run build && npm --workspace @photo-tools/archivio-flow run build:server && node ./scripts/copy-archivio-server.mjs
scripts.build:image-converter: npm run build:shell && npm --workspace @photo-tools/image-converter run build
scripts.build:image-file-finder: npm run build:shell && npm --workspace @photo-tools/image-file-finder run build
scripts.build:photo-selector: npm run build:shell && npm --workspace @photo-tools/photo-selector-app run build
scripts.start:image-party-frame: npm run build:image-party-frame && cross-env FILEX_TOOL=image-party-frame electron .
scripts.start:batch-print-layout: npm run build:batch-print-layout && cross-env FILEX_TOOL=batch-print-layout electron .
scripts.start:archivio-flow: npm run build:archivio-flow && cross-env FILEX_TOOL=archivio-flow electron .
scripts.start:image-converter: npm run build:image-converter && cross-env FILEX_TOOL=image-converter electron .
scripts.start:image-file-finder: npm run build:image-file-finder && cross-env FILEX_TOOL=image-file-finder electron .
scripts.start:photo-selector: npm run build:photo-selector && cross-env FILEX_TOOL=photo-selector-app electron .
scripts.start:suite: npm run build:suite && cross-env FILEX_TOOL=suite-launcher electron .
scripts.dev:image-converter: npm run build:shell && concurrently -k "npm --workspace @photo-tools/image-converter run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4185" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:4185 && cross-env FILEX_TOOL=image-converter FILEX_RENDERER_MODE=dev FILEX_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4185 electron ."
scripts.dev:image-file-finder: npm run build:shell && concurrently -k "npm --workspace @photo-tools/image-file-finder run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4215" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:4215 && cross-env FILEX_TOOL=image-file-finder FILEX_RENDERER_MODE=dev FILEX_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4215 electron ."
scripts.dev:batch-print-layout: npm run build:shell && concurrently -k "npm --workspace @photo-tools/batch-print-layout run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4205" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:4205 && cross-env FILEX_TOOL=batch-print-layout FILEX_RENDERER_MODE=dev FILEX_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4205 electron ."
scripts.dev:photo-selector: npm run build:shell && concurrently -k "npm --workspace @photo-tools/photo-selector-app run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4175" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:4175 && cross-env FILEX_TOOL=photo-selector-app FILEX_RENDERER_MODE=dev FILEX_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4175 electron ."
scripts.dist:suite:win: npm run build:suite && cross-env FILEX_TOOL=suite-launcher electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:image-party-frame:win: npm run build:image-party-frame && cross-env FILEX_TOOL=image-party-frame electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --win nsis --publish never
scripts.dist:image-party-frame:mac: npm run build:image-party-frame && cross-env FILEX_TOOL=image-party-frame electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --mac dmg zip --publish never
scripts.dist:batch-print-layout:win: npm run build:batch-print-layout && cross-env FILEX_TOOL=batch-print-layout electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --win nsis --x64 --ia32 --publish never
scripts.dist:batch-print-layout:win64: npm run build:batch-print-layout && cross-env FILEX_TOOL=batch-print-layout electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:batch-print-layout:mac: npm run build:batch-print-layout && cross-env FILEX_TOOL=batch-print-layout electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --mac dmg zip --publish never
scripts.dist:archivio-flow:win: npm run build:archivio-flow && cross-env FILEX_TOOL=archivio-flow electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --win nsis --x64 --ia32 --publish never
scripts.dist:archivio-flow:win64: npm run build:archivio-flow && cross-env FILEX_TOOL=archivio-flow electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:archivio-flow:win32: npm run build:archivio-flow && cross-env FILEX_TOOL=archivio-flow electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --win nsis --ia32 --publish never
scripts.dist:archivio-flow:mac: npm run build:archivio-flow && cross-env FILEX_TOOL=archivio-flow electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --mac dmg zip --publish never
scripts.dist:image-converter:win: npm run build:image-converter && cross-env FILEX_TOOL=image-converter electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --win nsis --x64 --ia32 --publish never
scripts.dist:image-converter:win64: npm run build:image-converter && cross-env FILEX_TOOL=image-converter electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:image-converter:win32: npm run build:image-converter && cross-env FILEX_TOOL=image-converter electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --win nsis --ia32 --publish never
scripts.dist:image-converter:mac: npm run build:image-converter && cross-env FILEX_TOOL=image-converter electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --mac dmg zip --publish never
scripts.dist:image-file-finder:win: npm run build:image-file-finder && cross-env FILEX_TOOL=image-file-finder electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --win nsis --x64 --ia32 --publish never
scripts.dist:image-file-finder:win64: npm run build:image-file-finder && cross-env FILEX_TOOL=image-file-finder electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:image-file-finder:win32: npm run build:image-file-finder && cross-env FILEX_TOOL=image-file-finder electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --win nsis --ia32 --publish never
scripts.dist:image-file-finder:mac: npm run build:image-file-finder && cross-env FILEX_TOOL=image-file-finder electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --mac dmg zip --publish never
scripts.dist:photo-selector:win: npm run build:photo-selector && cross-env FILEX_TOOL=photo-selector-app electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --win nsis --x64 --ia32 --publish never
scripts.dist:photo-selector:win64: npm run build:photo-selector && cross-env FILEX_TOOL=photo-selector-app electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:photo-selector:win32: npm run build:photo-selector && cross-env FILEX_TOOL=photo-selector-app electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --win nsis --ia32 --publish never
scripts.dist:photo-selector:mac: npm run build:photo-selector && cross-env FILEX_TOOL=photo-selector-app electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.mjs --mac dmg zip --publish never
scripts.dist:all-tools:win: npm run dist:image-party-frame:win && npm run dist:batch-print-layout:win64 && npm run dist:archivio-flow:win64 && npm run dist:image-converter:win64 && npm run dist:image-file-finder:win64 && npm run dist:photo-selector:win64 && npm run dist:suite:win
